Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misclassified Da Nang’s region as Southern Vietnam and conflated “Miền Nam” with “Nam Trung Bộ.” The Zone 5 Military Museum is in Da Nang, which is in the South Central Coast (Nam Trung Bộ), i.e., Central Vietnam (Miền Trung). This incorrect regional assignment led to the wrong final answer.
